questions.question: If the slant height and radius of a cone are 12 cm and 7 cm, respectively, then find the total surface area.
questions.solution:
**Given**

The slant height of the cone = 12 cm

Radius of cone = 7 cm

**Concept:**

**The total** surface area of a cone = π × r × (r + l), where r is the radius and l is the slant height.

**Solution:**

⇒ Total surface area = π × r × (r + l)

⇒ Total surface area = 22/7 × 7 cm × (7 cm + 12 cm)

⇒ Total surface area = 418 cm²

**Hence, the total surface area of the cone is 418 cm².**

questions.question: A shopkeeper announces a discount of 18% on every item in his store. What price should a customer pay for an item of Rs. 5,583? (in Rs., rounded off to the nearest integer)
questions.solution:
**Given**

Initial price of item = Rs. 5583

Discount = 18%

**Concept:**

Price after discount = Initial price - (Initial price × Discount/100)

**Solution:**

⇒ Price after discount = Rs. 5583 - (Rs. 5583 × 18/100)

⇒ Price after discount = Rs. 4578

**Therefore, the customer should pay Rs. 4578 for the item.**

questions.question: The population of a town is 64,000 which grows by 1/8th of its current population every year. What will be the population after two years?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Initial population = 64,000

Annual growth = 1/8

**Concept:**

The population after n years, growing annually at a rate of r, can be calculated as population × (1 + r)ⁿ.

**Solution:**

⇒ Population after 2 years = 64,000 × (1 + 1/8)²

⇒ Population after 2 years = 81000

**Therefore, the population after two years will be 81,000.**

questions.question: Akshit is selling a suitcase marked at Rs. 5,000 by offering a 10% discount, and further offers a 10% discount if the payment is made in cash. A customer bought the suitcase from Akshit and paid him in cash. How much amount (in Rs.) did he pay to Akshit?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs. 5,000

Initial discount = 10%

Cash payment discount = 10%

**Concept:**

The final price after two discounts is Marked Price × (1 - initial discount) × (1 - cash discount).

**Solution:**

⇒ Final price = Rs. 5,000 × (1 - 10/100) × (1 - 10/100)

⇒ Final price = Rs. 4,050

**Hence, the customer paid Rs. 4,050 to Akshit.**

questions.question: A milkman bought 90 litres of milk for Rs. 1,630 and added 15 litres of water. If he sells it at Rs. 19.00 per litre, his profit percentage will be:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Cost of milk = Rs. 1630 for 90 litres

Added water = 15 litres

Selling price = Rs. 19.00 per litre

**Concept:**

Profit percentage = (Selling Price - Cost Price)/Cost Price × 100%

**Solution:**

⇒ Total volume = 90 litres + 15 litres = 105 litres

⇒ Total selling price = 105 litres × Rs. 19.00 per litre = Rs. 1995

⇒ Profit percentage = (Rs. 1995 - Rs. 1630)/Rs. 1630 × 100%

⇒ Profit percentage = 22 (64)/(163) \%

**Hence, the profit percentage is 22 (64)/(163) \%.**

questions.question: What is the percentage loss when the cost price and selling price of an article are in the ratio of 5 ∶ 3?
questions.solution:
**Given Data:** Cost price to selling price ratio = 5 ∶ 3

**Concept:** Loss percentage = (Cost Price - Selling Price) / Cost Price × 100%

**Solution:**

⇒ Loss percentage = (5 - 3) / 5 × 100%

⇒ Loss percentage = 40%

**Hence, the loss percentage is 40%.**

questions.question: Ranu can finish a piece of work in 10 days while Ruby can finish the same work in 15 days. In how many days the whole work will be finished. If they work on alternate days, starting with Ranu?
questions.solution:
**Given Data:**

Ranu's work completion time = 10 days

Ruby's work completion time = 15 days

**Concept:** When two people work on alternate days, the total time taken is 2 × (LCM of individual times / sum of individual rates of work)

**Solution:**

⇒ Ranu's rate of work = 1/10 per day

⇒ Ruby's rate of work = 1/15 per day

⇒ LCM of 10 and 15 = 30

⇒ Total time taken = 2 × (30 / (1/10 + 1/15)) = 12 days

**Hence, the work will be finished in 12 days when Ranu and Ruby work on alternate days.**

questions.question: If x% of y is equal to 2/3 of 90, then the value of xy is _______.
questions.solution:
**Given**

x% of y = 90

**Concept:**

If x% of y is z, then y = 100 × z/x.

**Solution:**

⇒ xy = 100 × (90) × 2/3

⇒ Therefore xy = 9000 × 2/3 = 6000

**Hence, the value of xy is 6000.**

questions.question: P takes 12 minutes to complete one round of a circular track and R takes 18 minutes to complete the same round. questions.question: A car takes 5 hours to cover a distance, if its speed is 30 km/h. What should be its speed to cover the same distance in 2.5 hours?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Distance covered by car = D (unknown)

Time taken with speed 30 km/h = 5 hours

Desired time to cover the same distance = 2.5 hours

**Concept:**

If the distance remains the same, then the speed is inversely proportional to the time taken to cover that distance.

**Solution:**

⇒ Initial speed = 30 km/h

⇒ Distance = Speed × Time = 30 km/h × 5 hours = 150 km

⇒ Required speed = Distance/Desired Time = 150 km/2.5 hours = 60 km/h

**Hence, the car should travel at 60 km/h to cover the same distance in 2.5 hours.**

questions.question: If the average marks of two batches of 45 and 50 students, respectively, are 78 and 65 , then the average marks of all the students are:
questions.solution:
**Given**

Batch 1: 45 students, average marks = 78

Batch 2: 50 students, average marks = 65

**Concept:**

The total average of all students = Total Sum of marks/Total number of students

**Solution:**

⇒ Total marks of batch 1 = 45 students × 78 marks = 3510 marks

⇒ Total marks of batch 2 = 50 students × 65 marks = 3250 marks

⇒ Total marks of both batches = 3510 marks + 3250 marks = 6760 marks

⇒ Total number of students = 45 students + 50 students = 95 students

⇒ Average marks = Total marks/Total number of students = 6760 marks/95 students = 1352/19

**Hence, the average marks of all the students is approximately 1352/19 marks.**

questions.question: If 'a' and 'b' are prime numbers, which of the following CANNOT be the sum of 'a' and 'b' ? (Where a and b are distinct prime numbers)
questions.solution:
**Given**

a and b are distinct prime numbers

**Concept:**

The sum of two prime numbers is always even, except for the case 2 + odd prime.

**Solution:**

We know that 2 is the only even prime number. All other prime numbers are odd.

For the sum to be even, both numbers must be even, or both must be odd.

Now, using the above statements:

 
• '6' is an even number. At first glance, you could add two prime numbers and get '6' (2 and another prime number), but the other prime number in this case would also have to be '4' (6-2), but '4' is not a prime number. So, '6' cannot be the sum of two distinct prime numbers.
 
• '10' is an even number. It can be the sum of two primes: 3 and 7 or 5 and 5.
 
• '28' is an even number. It can be the sum of two primes: 23 and 5 or 11 and 17.
 
• '14' is an even number. It can be the sum of two primes: 7 and 7 or 3 and 11.

Using the above comparisons, **we can conclude that '6' is the only option that cannot be the sum of two distinct prime numbers**.

questions.question: Pramod, Akhil, and Raman can do a piece of work in 14 days. Akhil and Raman can do the same work in 77 days. Find the number of days in which Pramod can complete the same work.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Pramod, Akhil, and Raman can do a piece of work in 14 days.

Akhil and Raman can do the same work in 77 days.

**Concept:**

Work done is directly proportional to the number of days and the number of workers.

**Solution:**

⇒ The combined rate of Pramod, Akhil, and Raman = 1/14 work/day

⇒ The combined rate of Akhil and Raman = 1/77 work/day

⇒ The rate of Pramod = 1/14 - 1/77 = 9/154 work/day

⇒ Therefore, the time Pramod would take = 154/9 days

**Hence, Pramod can complete the same work in 154/9 days.**

questions.question: The average age of husband and wife is 24 years. The age of their son is 1/9th of the age of the husband. The wife is 6 years younger to the husband. Find the average age of all three members of family.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Average age of husband and wife = 24 years

Age of their son is 1/9th of the age of the husband

Wife is 6 years younger than the husband

**Concept:**

Average age = Total age/Number of individuals

**Solution:**

⇒ Total age of husband and wife = 24 years × 2 = 48 years

⇒ Age of husband = (48 years + 6 years)/2 = 27 years

⇒ Age of son = 27 years/9 = 3 years

⇒ Total age of all three = 48 years + 3 years = 51 years

⇒ Average age of all three = 51 years/3 = 17 years

**Hence, the average age of all three members of the family is 17 years.**

questions.question: Due to leakage in a tank, there are 220 liters of water left in the tank which originally held 240 liters. What is percent loss of water?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Original amount of water = 240 liters

Amount of water left due to leakage = 220 liters

**Concept:**

Percentage loss = (Initial Quantity - Final Quantity)/initial Quantity × 100%

**Solution:**

⇒ Percentage loss = (240 liters - 220 liters)/240 liters × 100% = 20/240 × 100% = 8.33%

**Hence, the percent loss of water is 8.33%.**
